Forge Your Legend

BASE BUILDING

Build Your Stronghold

350+ unique buildings across 9 distinct factions. Progress through three town hall tiers to unlock advanced structures. Master four resources — gold, lumber, stone, and oil. Fortify your base with upgradeable walls, towers, and paths that boost unit movement speed.

COMBAT

Command Your Army

310+ units across 9 factions and 17 roles. Workers gather resources. Infantry holds the line. Ranged units rain fire. Siege engines level fortifications. Spellcasters unleash devastating magic. Flying units control the skies. A full navy commands the seas. And legendary heroes lead them all — with 780+ tech upgrades and 610+ spells to master.

Render Modes

Three Ways to See the Battle

Hand-painted 2D sprites for purists. Pre-baked 3D impostors — lit and rendered from the real model, delivered as sprites — for the default experience. Or experimental Live 3D for players who want the full WebGL treatment.

Toggle between modes any time in Settings. Browse every unit and building in the in-game Extras → 3D Model Viewer.

Live 3D is desktop-only — phones and tablets stay on the pre-baked 3D sprites, which look nearly identical at a fraction of the bandwidth.

· Units ·Clanrat — the ratmen rank-and-file

Mode 01

Classic 2D

Hand-crafted sprites — the pixel-art heart of the genre. Crisp on every display, kind to every CPU.

Mode 02
8 dirs

Pre-baked 3D

Eight directions rendered from the 3D model, baked to sprites. Full 3D lighting at 2D cost. This is the default.

Experimental
Mode 03

Live 3D

The actual GLB loaded into WebGL with real-time animation — idle, walk, attack — cycled on the fly. Click Load Live 3D on desktop; mobile stays on the lightweight video loop.

· Buildings ·Grand Warren — the ratmen town hall

The full building model, slowly rotating. Every beam, every banner, every rusted nail. Click Load Live 3D on desktop; mobile stays on the lightweight video loop.

Choose Your Faction

Nine playable civilizations, each with distinct units, buildings, and playstyles — plus the untamed Wilds that contest every map.

Dwarves

Campaign

Steel and Stone. Honor and Ale.

For three centuries, the Dwarves have held Greyhelm Hold — a fortress carved into the living mountain. Led by Thane Borin Stonefist, they are master builders, fierce warriors, and stubborn as the stone they mine. When green-skinned strangers appear in the lowlands, the mountain folk must decide: defend their borders, or strike first.

21 units29 buildings3 heroes
Explore Faction→

Goblins

Campaign

Cunning and Chaos. Survival at Any Cost.

Driven from their poisoned homeland, the Ashland clans crossed treacherous seas on leaking barges. Led by Grizzik One-Ear, they are survivors — scrappy, inventive, and ruthlessly pragmatic. In this new land of stone and snow, they must build, breed, and fight for every scrap of territory the dwarves consider theirs.

21 units29 buildings3 heroes
Explore Faction→

Ratmen

From the Depths, We Rise.

Beneath the mountains, the Sketh'kai breed in endless warrens. Part rat, part cunning intelligence, they swarm through tunnels and caverns with warpstone-fueled technology and plague-ridden priests. Their Clanrats fight in pairs, overwhelming foes with sheer numbers while Jezzail snipers and Spark Cannons tear through armor.

21 units32 buildings4 heroes
Explore Faction→

Lizardmen

Ancient Blood. Celestial Wrath.

The Itzal are an ancient civilization of cold-blooded warriors guided by the stars. Their Saurus warriors are bred for war, while Skink priests channel celestial magic. Kroxigors crush fortifications with brute strength, and from the skies, Terradons and the great Coatl rain destruction upon lesser races.

20 units32 buildings4 heroes
Explore Faction→

Wood Elves

The Forest Remembers. The Forest Strikes.

Guardians of the ancient groves, the Verdant Court fights to protect the wild places. Their Bladedancers weave through enemies with grace, while Eagle riders patrol the canopy. Spirit Trees channel the living forest itself, and their Mages draw power from the ley lines that run beneath the roots of the world.

21 units30 buildings4 heroes
Explore Faction→

High Elves

Light Eternal. Magic Supreme.

The Luminari are the oldest civilization of elves, builders of crystal spires and masters of arcane magic. Their Champions are peerless in combat, their Mages channel raw starlight, and their Dragons are the most feared creatures in the sky. They fight not for conquest, but to preserve the order of the world.

21 units32 buildings4 heroes
Explore Faction→

Dark Elves

Shadows Obey. Empires Fall.

Exiled from the Luminari for forbidden magic, the Umbral Pact embraces the shadows. Their Shadow Ships slip unseen through enemy waters, their Mages weave spells of darkness and decay, and their Dragons breathe shadow-fire. They seek not just victory, but the complete annihilation of those who cast them out.

22 units29 buildings4 heroes
Explore Faction→

Humans

Faith, Steel, and the Crown.

The kingdom of Valoria stands as a bastion of order in a world of chaos. Led by knights, paladins, and battle priests, the Valorian Host marches under the Eternal Flame — a holy order dedicated to protecting the realm. With trebuchets, war wagons, and griffin riders at their command, they bring overwhelming force tempered by unwavering faith.

20 units29 buildings3 heroes
Explore Faction→

Undead

Death is not the end. It is the beginning.

From the fallen kingdom of Moranthia rise the Hollowed Host — scholars who conquered death itself. Led by necromancers and death knights, they raise armies from the battlefield's fallen. Skeletons march in endless ranks, vampires hunt the living, and bone dragons darken the skies. Every enemy slain becomes another soldier in their inexorable advance.

20 units29 buildings3 heroes
Explore Faction→

The Wilds

Non-Playable

The land answers to no banner.

Long before the great races drew their borders, the wild places were already full. Sellswords drift between the warring kingdoms selling their blades to the highest bidder; ancient troll-vaults trade relics to any hero bold enough to approach; spirit-fed pools mend the wounded and the weary. And in the dark between settlements lurk the creeps — kobolds, wolves, trolls and ogres that answer to no crown and guard their hoards with tooth and claw. The Wilds cannot be commanded, only contested, courted, or culled.

Ways to Play

From solo campaigns to AI spectating to competitive multiplayer - choose your battlefield.

🤖

AI Commander

LLM-Powered Opponent

Face off against an AI commander powered by a large language model. It reads the battlefield, adapts its strategy in real-time, and responds in a unique race-specific voice. Hold V to speak your commands — or type them — and hear your opponent talk back.

  • Voice commands (hold V to talk)
  • Race-specific AI voices
  • Natural language chat
  • Adaptive strategy
👁️

AI vs AI Spectator

Watch & Learn

Sit back and watch two AI commanders battle it out. Switch playback between 1x, 2x and 4x, track real-time stats, and learn strategies by observing how the AI plays.

  • Playback speed 1x, 2x or 4x
  • Live stats overlay
  • Pick AI difficulty
🗺️

Map Editor

Create & Share

Design your own battlefields with a full-featured map editor. Place terrain, resources, buildings, units, and spawn points. Publish your maps for the community to play.

  • 10 tools, 5 terrain brushes
  • Entity placement
  • Publish & browse maps
⚔️

Multiplayer PvP

Real-Time Battles

Challenge real opponents in 1v1 multiplayer with deterministic lockstep networking. Create or join a lobby, chat before and during the match, and track your wins and losses.

  • 1v1 real-time matches
  • Lobby system with chat
  • Host-set victory conditions
  • Win/loss tracking
🏰

Campaign

32 Story Missions

Play through two full campaigns - one for each faction. 16 missions across 4 acts in each, with hero progression, boss battles, and naval warfare.

  • Two full campaigns
  • Hero leveling
  • Cinematic briefings
🎲

Skirmish

Custom Battles

Set up the perfect battle. Choose your faction, map type, biome, size, AI difficulty - and how the match can be won, from plain conquest to Wonders, Relics, Regicide or King of the Hill.

  • 4 map types & biomes
  • 3 AI difficulties
  • 7 victory conditions
  • Custom map support

THE STORY

“Three weeks on leaking barges. Half the fleet sank in the Straits. But we made it. This valley... it will do.”

- Grizzik One-Ear

Two peoples. One land. The ancient Dwarves of Greyhelm have held their mountain fortress for three centuries - but now a desperate goblin horde arrives on their shores, fleeing a poisoned homeland. Neither side can back down. What begins as border skirmishes will escalate into a war that reshapes the world. Play both sides of the conflict across 32 campaign missions.
